# Justin LeBlanc private-event music

> A direct way to plan music for private gatherings, celebrations, corporate receptions, and wedding inquiries.

- Canonical website: https://justinleblancmusic.50by50.dev/
- Event inquiry: https://justinleblancmusic.50by50.dev/plan-your-event/
- Current public site: https://justinleblancmusic.com/
Sending this form starts a conversation; it does not confirm your date. Public performance dates
are available on the homepage when they are confirmed for sharing.
